title: Restriction to a localized site is exact
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a Grothendieck site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $W$ be an object. Give $\mathcal C/W$ the localized topology, with coverings whose underlying families cover in $\mathcal C$. For the abelian sheaf categories [def-sp-abelian], the restriction functor $j_W^*:\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C/W)$ is exact: for every short exact sequence $0\to G_1\to G_2\to G_3\to0$ on $\mathcal C$, the sequence $0\to j_W^*G_1\to j_W^*G_2\to j_W^*G_3\to0$ is exact on $\mathcal C/W$.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DJ (lemma-extension-by-zero-exact), restriction exactness assertion

proof.text: Write F = J.toGrothendieck.overPullback AddCommGrpCat W. By Mathlib CategoryTheory/Sites/Over.lean:276-291, this is the continuous sheaf pushforward along Over.forget W, which is also cocontinuous. Mathlib Functor.sheafAdjunctionCocontinuous (Sites/CoverLifting.lean:322-327) identifies F as the left adjoint of the sheaf pushforward defined by right Kan extension. The required pointwise right Kan extensions exist because the sites are small and AddCommGrpCat has small limits. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits], namely Adjunction.leftAdjoint_preservesColimits, to obtain PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u,u} F, hence preservation of finite colimits.

The proved library instance Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_sheafPushforwardContinuous (WeilConjectures/Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/Continuous.lean:93-95) gives PreservesFiniteLimits F. Preservation of the terminal zero object also supplies PreservesZeroMorphisms F. Apply ShortComplex.ShortExact.map_of_exact (Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/ShortComplex/ShortExact.lean:107-113) to hS and F. This gives precisely the unchanged conclusion that the restricted short complex is short exact.
